design_basis.pillar: zombie-crisis-reference 支柱 4：僵尸差异化不是换皮改血量，每种必须逼出不同的玩家应对
design_basis.gap: 现在 3 种僵尸只有 2 个模型，普通僵尸和疾行僵尸共用 ZombieTarget.tscn。疾行僵尸的设计意图是逼玩家预瞄、保持移动，但玩家看不出哪个是疾行的，直到它冲到脸上——这个类型的玩法意图根本没传达出去。
design_basis.requirement: 轮廓必须在僵尸堆里、2.5D 俯视下、一眼分辨。靠体型和姿态区分，不能只靠颜色，因为血雾和暗光会吃掉颜色。
design_basis.style_note: 现有僵尸是无贴图的低模平涂（纯绿/纯蓝色块），新玩家角色是带贴图的厚涂。两者同屏严重违和，新角色越精致旧僵尸越像占位。因此新僵尸对齐新角色画风，不对齐旧僵尸。

rig.pose: T-pose，臂展大于身高（实测 Zombie_Basic X=1.888 / Z=1.362），与玩家骨架同约定

shared_style.outline: rough uneven thick black ink outline, scratchy internal ink
shared_style.shading: flat two-step cel shading, hard shadow edge, no smooth gradient
shared_style.decay: hand-painted rot: sunken cheeks, exposed teeth, torn clothing, dried blood, dirt

zombies.answer: 基础压力，应对方式是瞄准
zombies.build: average adult build, slouched shoulders, head tilted, arms hanging heavy
zombies.build_en: average adult build, slouched shoulders, head tilted forward, arms hanging heavy
zombies.clothing_en: torn office shirt with missing sleeve, ruined trousers, one shoe missing
zombies.palette_note_en: rotted olive-grey skin, faded grey-green clothing, dried blood dark red
zombies.silhouette_en: the baseline: a normal-sized slouched human. Every other type must read as a deviation from this one.

zombies.answer: 同上，仅用于人群外观多样性
zombies.build_en: average adult build, one shoulder lower than the other, slight limp stance
zombies.clothing_en: torn hi-visibility work vest over a ripped shirt, heavy work boots, tool belt hanging loose
zombies.palette_note_en: rotted olive-grey skin, dirty faded safety-yellow vest, dried blood dark red
zombies.silhouette_en: same mass as the civilian but with a bulkier vest and boots, so a crowd does not read as clones

zombies.answer: 同上，仅用于人群外观多样性
zombies.build_en: average adult build, stiff upright shoulders, jaw hanging open
zombies.clothing_en: shredded police uniform with torn duty belt and empty holster, one boot
zombies.palette_note_en: rotted olive-grey skin, dark navy uniform faded to grey-blue, dried blood dark red
zombies.silhouette_en: same mass as the civilian but squarer shoulders from the uniform, so a crowd does not read as clones

zombies.answer: 快速拉近距离，应对方式是预瞄并保持移动
zombies.build_en: gaunt and wiry, noticeably LEANER and slightly shorter than the baseline, deep hunch with the head thrust forward ahead of the shoulders, long thin arms trailing back behind the body, coiled sprinter stance
zombies.clothing_en: almost no clothing left, only shredded rags at the waist, exposed ribs and sinew
zombies.palette_note_en: pale bloodless grey-tan skin, raw dark red exposed muscle along the arms and ribs, ragged brown scraps
zombies.silhouette_en: the thinnest and most forward-leaning shape in the roster. Even as a small dark shape in a crowd it must read as 'this one is fast', by hunch and thinness alone, not by colour.

zombies.answer: 高血量、缓慢、挡路，应对方式是集火或绕行
zombies.build_en: enormously bloated and heavy, roughly twice the body mass of the baseline and clearly taller, massive swollen torso and gut, thick tree-trunk arms hanging far from the body, tiny head sunk between huge shoulders
zombies.clothing_en: filthy oversized boiler suit and overalls stretched tight over the gut and split at the seams, torn work shirt underneath; only head, hands and feet show skin
zombies.palette_note_en: swollen brown-ochre skin stretched tight, dark brown rags, dried blood dark red
zombies.silhouette_en: the widest and heaviest shape in the roster. Must read as a wall at a glance, the opposite extreme from the runner.
zombies.clothing_note: 必须穿衣覆盖。裸露大面积肿胀伤口皮肉的版本连续四次被 Tripo 以 error_code 2008 拒绝（内容审核），换成被撑破的工装覆盖后一次通过。四视图宽高比不一致不是原因——通过那版的 right 视图比失败版本更不一致。
